svg.title: Luneta. Eligibility rules hide inside long research funding calls. It shows each rule next to the sentence it came from. A check without AI confirms the quote exists; otherwise the rule is marked unconfirmed. My part: Project management, product discovery, brand and site copy. Accountable for the site and user experience in a team of five. Result: Public site listing 179 calls from 10 funding agencies (12 Nov 2026). IME's InovaIME portal links to it as a prototype in testing. Team's stack: Python, Docling, language models, a rule-based quote check, Next.js, TypeScript.
